text: The new test has 12 ASSERT_EQ/ASSERT_TRUE call sites without a streamed diagnostic message. Its table comments and test names do not supply an assertion message. The two production MOZ_ASSERT(mGotHeader) calls also omit an explicit message. Record this as a scoped diagnostics finding under the user assertion guidance; it is not a failed test result or a new rule learned from this patch.
title: The new MailStream assertions omit explicit expected-behavior messages
